senses.gloss: to shine, be bright (corresp. to h. זרח).
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 32:32">Targ. Gen. XXXII, 32</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27:1">Lev. R. s. 27</cite> <he>ושמשא דַּנְחָא וכ׳</he> does the sun shine in your country?; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33:1">Gen. R. s. 33</cite> <he>אית גבכון שמשא דנח</he>; Tanḥ. Emor 6; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 2:5:7">Y. B. Mets. II, 8ᶜ</cite> bot.
